text:
deploy-bot: Rolling deployment complete: inference-api v3.10.0 -> prod-eu (canary 10%). Starting post-deploy synthetic suite: chat-stream-prefill, kv-warmup, embed-echo. run=sniff-3098765432
clare: heads-up dashboard: chat-stream p99 spiking to ~1.4s vs baseline 220ms. spike started ~40s after canary.
josh: seeing chat-stream partial chunks dropped on a subset of hosts, looks like prefix prefill misses. attaching a short trace.
meera: paste trace? suspect KV warmup not populating due to TTL mismatch between prefill script and runtime.
clare: trace snippet: ```[sniffer] 00:42 prefilling key user:abc prefix missing then regenerate -> extra latency. node=svc-11 shard=eu2```
lia: ops-bot kv-check ran and flagged memcache evictions on svc-11 around same time. eviction ratio ~12% for the canary shard.
ops-bot: auto-mitigation: did not trigger failover because route tag matched exact variant. Fallback policy requires variant=elastic-prefill which the artifact did not include.
tony: hmm that matches the last-minute artifact change where prefill script TTL was shortened to 30s for test. we forgot to sync runtime prefill policy.
josh: impact: increased tail latency on streaming responses for a small percent of requests (0.8% of canary), but no 5xxs. still in change window?
clare: yes within the scheduled 2h change window, but we should avoid blasting users. propose pin prod-eu traffic to v3.9.3 while we hotfix.
meera: alternative: quick rollout hold + patch artifact to restore TTL to 5m and ensure variant tag elastic-prefill is present; then resume canary. prefer patch over full rollback.
tony: can we hotpatch memcache eviction thresholds? might be risky given load.
lia: ops-bot recommends patch + pin traffic to old until next canary. ops-bot will assist with pin.
ops-bot: pin command prepared: `rdctl pin --service inference-api --region prod-eu --to v3.9.3 --duration 30m --note "kv-prefill-ttl-mismatch"`
deploy-bot: Executing pin per plan. Canary traffic will be shifted back to v3.9.3 over 60s.
clare: I'll open a tracking ticket and add telemetry tags `sniffer.chatstream.tail` and `kv.prefill.evictions`.
josh: created ticket RD-3301 https://redwood.internal/issue/RD-3301 with traces and eviction stats.
meera: pushing a patch to artifact builder now to set TTL=300s and include variant tagelastic-prefill. will run CI preflight that includes a kv-tagging check.
tonY: (typo) meant: will run load check after patch.
clare: small ask: include a release-note blurb about brief pinning and follow-up fix. I'll draft.
ops-bot: Pin complete. Active version prod-eu: v3.9.3. Canary halted.
deploy-bot: Sniffer suite paused for this wave.
lia: once patched artifact is ready, propose quick canary (5% for 10m) then standard sniffer run. @meera to own verification.
meera: ack. will post results in RD-3301.
clare: follow-ups: 1) add KV TTL sanity check to release preflight 2) enforce variant-tag presence in artifact metadata 3) document pinned window in release notes.
josh: +1. Also let's add a small synthetic that asserts no more than 1% tail degradation during post-deploy for streaming routes.
clare: agreed. adding to RD-3301 checklist.
ops-bot: Closing loop: brief pin executed, hotfix in progress, will resume verification after patched canary run.
